caption: The drawing depicts a four-wheeled carriage with thin, spoked black wheels, two at the front and two at the rear, attached to a lightweight black frame. The main seating area consists of a blue upholstered cushion with a pattern and a matching padded backrest, both areas bordered with black and blue details. Above the seat, an ornate canopy is supported by two decorative vertical rods, each adorned with circular designs; the canopy is black with blue embellishments along the edge and blue tassels hanging from the trim. Two long black handles extend upwards and outwards from the rear, with the end crossbar wrapped or painted in a contrasting reddish color. The background is a plain beige. The signature “David Ramage” appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Doll Go-Cart
